title: Bounce Rally
brief: Top-down road that scrolls upward. Your small car bumps other cars sideways off the road into rocks and ditches for points. Press jump to hop over gaps, rivers and broken bridges, and land on enemy cars to crush them. Land in water and you lose a life. Each level gets longer gaps and tougher cars that bump back.

title: Grid Sprint
brief: Racing seen from just behind your car, road curving toward a horizon. First a timed qualifying lap sets your start place, then a race against 7 rivals with a checkpoint timer. Hitting roadside signs spins you out. Shift between low and high gear; high is fast but slow to recover after a crash.

title: Interceptor Run
brief: Top-down highway, scrolling up. You drive an armed agent car. Shoot or ram the enemy cars (blade wheels, armored trucks, a helicopter dropping bombs) but never hit the plain civilian cars or you lose points. Drive into the back of a supply truck to get a new weapon: oil slick, smoke screen, missiles. Where the road ends at the water the car becomes a boat.

title: Block City Hustle
brief: Top-down open city of streets, blocks and a park. Walk, take any car, and take jobs from ringing phone booths: deliver a package, chase a target, race across town in time. Causing trouble raises a heat meter of 1 to 5 stars and more patrol cars chase you; a paint shop clears it. Cartoon tone, no blood.

title: Squad Buggy
brief: Third-person armored buggy on open hills. You steer; three soldier passengers ride along and shoot by themselves at the nearest enemy in range, and one stands at a mounted gun. Bumps can throw a soldier off; stop beside him to pick him up. Drive the squad to each flag, they hop out and hold it for 20 seconds while you circle and guard them.

title: Crater Crawler
brief: Side-scrolling six-wheel moon rover. Jump over craters and boulders, shoot forward at rocks and upward at saucers that drop bombs which make new craters. The course is split into lettered checkpoints A to Z with a time for each section.

title: Neon Drift Wastes
brief: Casual endless runner in a vaporwave cyber wasteland: pink and teal sunset, wireframe grid ground, broken statues, palm-tree antennas, floating glitch cubes. Your hover car slides between 3 lanes and jumps. Pick up data cassettes for score, dodge static walls and falling chrome pillars. Speed rises slowly; a "chill" pickup slows time. No enemies, just the drive and the colors.

title: Ramp Rider
brief: Side view dirt bike race against 3 riders over ramps and mud. Tilt the bike in the air to land flat; land badly and you tumble. Holding turbo heats the engine; overheat and you stop to cool down.

title: Fuel Line
brief: Top-down highway race against a fuel gauge, not a clock. Fuel only drops; grab fuel cans that sit between traffic. Some cars swerve into your lane on purpose; oil spots make you spin. Reach the finish before the tank is empty.

title: Tabletop Racers
brief: Tiny toy cars racing over a giant kitchen table, a desk and a bathtub edge, seen from above. Crumbs, pencils and spilled juice are the obstacles. Fall off the edge and you lose seconds. Pull too far ahead of a rival and they are out of the round.

title: Coast Road
brief: Racing seen from behind a convertible on a sunny coast road. At the end of each stage the road forks left (easier) or right (harder), so every run is a different route of 5 stages. Traffic, trucks and a time bonus at every checkpoint.

title: Wreck Ring
brief: Arena combat with cars. Ramps, a lava pit and pickups (rockets, mines, repair). Each car has health. Last car moving wins the round; best of 3.

title: Fare Dash
brief: Open-ish city taxi game. Pick up a waiting fare, an arrow points to where they want to go, and every second counts. Near misses and jumps earn tips. Clock gains time with every delivered fare.

title: Light Trail Arena
brief: Top-down grid arena. Two to four bikes leave solid glowing walls behind them and can only turn at right angles. Hit any wall and you are out. Speed boost pickup; the arena shrinks each round.
